messages.subject: Re: Ensembl CDF files
parts:
Hi Laura.

I've copied the aroma.affymetrix list in case others have the same
question.

I do have an Ensembl CDF files for Human Gene 1.0 ...

http://bioinf.wehi.edu.au/folders/mrobinson/exon/human_cdfs/
HuGene-1_0-st-v1_Ensembl47.cdf

It's created in much the same way as the Exon array ... and I think
it even uses the Exon array probeset identifiers in cases where the
probes are the same between arrays (I did this so that I could do a
comparison between them).

Some day when I get some free moments, I'd like to repeat this whole
CDF creation business for MoExon/MoGene and RaExon/RaGene ...

Hope that helps.

Cheers,
Mark


On 17/06/2008, at 9:43 PM, Laura Elo-Uhlgren wrote:

> Dear Mark Robinson,
>

> useful. Now, I have data also from the Human Gene 1.0 ST array and
> I tried to find a similar CDF file for that array - without
